meta.name: azure-kubernetes
meta.description: Plan, create, and configure production-ready Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) clusters. Covers Day-0 checklist, SKU selection (Automatic vs Standard), networking options (private API server, Azure CNI Overlay, egress configuration), security, and operations (autoscaling, upgrade strategy, cost analysis). WHEN: create AKS environment, provision AKS, enable AKS observability, design AKS networking, choose AKS SKU, secure AKS, optimize AKS, AKS spot nodes, AKS cluster-autoscaler, rightsize AKS pod, pod rightsizing, over-provisioned AKS pod, pod resource requests and limits, Vertical Pod Autoscaler, VPA recommendations.

copy.tagline: 规划、创建并配置生产就绪的 AKS 集群
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要部署和管理 Azure 上的 Kubernetes 集群
copy.tagline_en: Plan, create, and configure production-ready AKS clusters
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to deploy and manage Kubernetes clusters on Azure

howto.what: 这个技能让Claude帮你规划、创建和配置生产级的Azure Kubernetes Service（AKS）集群。它会根据你的需求，推荐集群类型（自动或标准）、网络方案、安全设置、监控方案、升级策略等，并区分创建前必须决定的配置和创建后可调整的配置。
howto.when: 当你需要创建新的AKS集群、规划生产环境配置、设计网络或安全方案、选择SKU、或优化集群性能时触发。

say.text: 帮我规划一个生产级AKS集群，需要高可用和自动扩缩容。
say.note: Claude会询问你的需求并给出推荐配置。

say.text: AKS自动版和标准版有什么区别？我该选哪个？
say.note: Claude会解释两者的差异并帮你做选择。

say.text: 我的AKS集群需要配置网络策略和出口流量控制。

howto.what_en: This skill enables Claude to help you plan, create, and configure production-ready Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) clusters. It recommends cluster type (Automatic vs Standard), networking, security, monitoring, upgrade strategy, and distinguishes Day-0 decisions from Day-1 features.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to create a new AKS cluster, plan production configuration, design networking or security, choose SKU, or optimize cluster performance.

say_en.text: Plan a production AKS cluster with high availability and autoscaling.
say_en.note: Claude will ask about your needs and give recommendations.

say_en.text: What's the difference between AKS Automatic and Standard? Which should I choose?
say_en.note: Claude explains the differences and helps you decide.

say_en.text: I need to configure network policy and egress control for my AKS cluster.
say_en.note: Claude recommends Azure CNI Overlay and Cilium.
